def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    equity_value = 150_000_000
    debt_value = 100_000_000
    preferred_value = 50_000_000
    equity_cost = 0.12
    debt_cost = 0.05
    preferred_cost = 0.08

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_value = equity_value + debt_value + preferred_value
    wacc = (
        (equity_value / total_value) * equity_cost
        + (debt_value / total_value) * debt_cost
        + (preferred_value / total_value) * preferred_cost
    )
    answer = f"{wacc * 100:.2f}%"

    # return answer
    return answer
